coupled_qualification: One cold-process observation per device/grid before and after, shared/unisolated machine. Synthetic producer-only FIM/finite PR receiver over dt=0.02 s. Fixed reservoir width 60 m, 3/30/300 cells, prescribed completion indices. Not a grid-convergence, Norne, million-cell or large dynamic-graph benchmark. Within-case request/model data are identical.

cpu.qualification:
Scalar vs spatial-batch physical stability checks on distinct PR states.

Property-kernel scaling only: these point counts are not reservoir sizes or a
whole-network throughput measure. Both paths retain all TPD starts/fallbacks.

cuda.qualification:
Scalar vs spatial-batch physical stability checks on distinct PR states.

Property-kernel scaling only: these point counts are not reservoir sizes or a
whole-network throughput measure. Both paths retain all TPD starts/fallbacks.

cpu.reference_mode: Every point delegated to original full PT/TPD validation

cuda.reference_mode: Every point delegated to original full PT/TPD validation

field_parity_qualification: Within EACH device: actual 300-cell reservoir fields against controlled reference delegating every point to the original full PT/TPD checks. Byte hashes are compared, not just float equality. Not a claim of bitwise equality across CPU and CUDA.

regression_stages.scope: CPU thermodynamics, single-point fast paths and real dynamic FIM after spatial integration
CPU spatial domains/fallbacks, finite apertures and thermal vessel integration
CUDA thermodynamics, spatial/pointwise paths, dynamic FIM and vessels
CPU gravity/inclined graphs and capillary phase-equilibrium coupling; one explicit CUDA case deferred
Deferred explicit CUDA phase extinction/rebirth case
Full 300-cell fields byte comparison with pointwise validation, CPU
Full 300-cell fields byte comparison with pointwise validation, CUDA
Final domain gates including alpha extrapolation rejection, CPU
Final domain gates including alpha extrapolation rejection, CUDA

retained_acceptance: Every original TPD start, EOS domain including positive PR alpha factor, chemical stationarity and positive curvature.
Unconfirmed or nonuniform-support points always receive the full original pointwise phase/fugacity check.
Positive batch memory budget and chunking; no unbounded cross-point Jacobian.
Original component/energy/entropy/quadrature/pressure and equipment-domain checks; full coarse/two-half temporal control.
No finite-area outlet quadrature points are removed, including dry/zero-area pieces.
qualification: Spatial batching of existing validation, no new constitutive closure or experimental calibration. The isothermal reservoir and current producer-only scope remain. All-five-goal completion is not claimed.
timing_window: Coupled timings cover Simulator.run_step and its in-step diagnostics; exclude imports/model construction and independent post-run audit. Property timings exclude state construction and declared warmup.
